hook: HE ASKED FOR *ONE CUP OF MILK
title: 18 · upamanyu · The Boy Who Asked for Milk
lines: A poor boy once asked God for a cup of milk.
little Upamanyu tasted real milk for the first time.
At home he asked for more.
His mother stirred flour into water, and smiled.
She cried. We have nothing, my son.
She cried. "We have nothing, my son.
Only Shiva can give you what I cannot.
Only Shiva can give you what I cannot."
He was six. He walked into the forest and sat down.
A king of the gods appeared.
Ask me. Gold. A kingdom. Anything.
I do not want you, said the boy.
"I do not want you," said the boy.
and his crown became a crescent moon.
All of it. A whole ocean. And a place at his side forever.
Do not settle for the first thing that offers. Ask the right one. That is sadhana.
